Who We Are

## Where Engineering Meets Resilience

"Ingeniería" means **engineering** in Spanish, symbolizing our commitment to innovation and precision in renewable energy. Founded and run entirely by former military personnel, Ingenieria blends the discipline of the armed forces with the foresight of modern solar engineering.

From large-scale ground-mount installations to intricate rooftop ventures, every project is delivered with a steadfast focus on excellence, safety and sustainability, earning the trust of India's biggest industrial names.

**Integrity**Discipline-driven, transparent delivery

**On-Time**Timely commissioning, every site

**Sustainability**Clean power, lower carbon footprint

**Precision**Military-grade quality control

Mission & Vision

## What We Work Towards

Olive Green to Go Green: a second innings of national service, one solar plant at a time.

### Our Mission

To accelerate India's transition to clean, reliable and affordable energy, delivering renewable-energy projects of uncompromising quality that empower communities, advance businesses and protect the environment for generations to come.

### Our Vision

To be India's most trusted, veteran-led renewable-energy partner, recognised nationwide for engineering excellence, safety and integrity, and for the enduring impact of every megawatt we bring online.

DisciplineIntegrityQuality & SafetySustainability

Message From The Leadership

## Lieutenant General A.R. Prasad (Retd)

AVSM, VSM, ADC, Ph.D · Former Signal Officer-in-Chief & Senior Colonel Commandant · Chief Executive Officer, INGENIERIA

In a rapidly changing world, the demand for sustainable energy solutions has never been greater. At Ingenieria, we stand at the forefront of this transformative era, blending the precision of engineering with the resilience and foresight honed through decades of military service.

Ingenieria is more than a company; it is a mission-driven organization committed to reshaping the renewable energy landscape. Our identity is deeply rooted in innovation and guided by values that have been the cornerstone of our leadership, discipline, integrity, and purpose. These principles drive us to excel not just in delivering projects but in crafting solutions that inspire trust, sustainability, and progress.

As a team comprised entirely of former military professionals, we bring a distinct approach to every challenge, strategic planning, decisive action, and an unwavering commitment to excellence. Our ISO 9001, ISO 14001, and ISO 45001 certifications reflect these values, reinforcing our dedication to delivering quality while prioritizing environmental care and occupational safety.

But at Ingenieria, our vision extends beyond energy production. We see ourselves as architects of change, creating solutions that empower communities, advance businesses, and align with the global push toward sustainability. As we continue to grow, our focus remains steadfast: to lead with purpose, innovate without boundaries, and collaborate for impact.

With warm regards,
Lieutenant General A.R. Prasad (Retd), AVSM, VSM, ADC, Ph.D
Chief Executive Officer, Ingenieria

What We Do

## End-to-End Solar EPC & Civil Solutions

Ingenieria is a full-spectrum renewable-energy contractor. We carry every project from the first feasibility study and geo-technical survey, through detailed engineering, Tier-1 procurement, piling, civil and electrical execution, right up to grid synchronisation, testing, and long-term operations & maintenance. From a single rooftop on a factory shed to a 300 MW utility-scale solar park, our ex-servicemen-led teams deliver with the precision, safety and accountability India's largest industrial houses demand. **Click any service below to explore our full capabilities, scope and project gallery.**

### CAPEX Solar EPC

Own your plant outright: we design, supply, build and commission it, and every unit it generates is yours.

[Learn more about CAPEX Solar EPC](https://arraysingenieria.com/capex-solar-epc/)

### Installation & Commissioning

Veteran-led I&C crews for EPC companies, developers and plant owners, built to your design and approved makes.

[Learn more about Installation & Commissioning](https://arraysingenieria.com/solar-installation-commissioning/)

### Ground-Mount Solar

Utility & industrial scale ground-mount power plants, engineered for maximum yield across deserts, plains and tea estates alike.

[Learn more about Ground-Mount Solar](https://arraysingenieria.com/service-ground-mount/)

### Rooftop Solar

On-grid RCC and metal rooftop PV systems for factories, institutions and homes, turning idle roofs into clean power assets.

[Learn more about Rooftop Solar](https://arraysingenieria.com/service-rooftop/)

### EPC Turnkey

Complete Engineering, Procurement & Construction, single-window delivery executed under Tata Power Solar EPC contracts.

[Learn more about EPC Turnkey](https://arraysingenieria.com/service-epc/)

### Pile Foundation & Piling

Specialist piling and pile-foundation works, proven on the 300 MW SECI project at Koppal and 5.5 MW Tata Motors, Jamshedpur.

[Learn more about Pile Foundation & Piling](https://arraysingenieria.com/service-piling/)

### Civil Works & Fencing

Pre-cast boundary walls, RCC works and chain-link fencing, including the 14.36 MW YIAPL solar project in Uttar Pradesh.

[Learn more about Civil Works & Fencing](https://arraysingenieria.com/service-civil/)

### O&M & Support

Operations, maintenance and statutory compliance, keeping every plant performing at peak efficiency, safely and reliably.

[Learn more about O&M & Support](https://arraysingenieria.com/service-om/)

How Solar Works

## From Sunlight to Savings

A clean, simple journey, engineered and managed end-to-end by our team.

1

### Sunlight Captured

Tier-1 solar panels convert sunlight into clean DC electricity.

2

#### Converted to Power

The inverter turns DC into usable AC for your home or plant.

3

#### Grid-Connected

Surplus power is exported to the grid and offset on your bill through net-metering.

4

#### Savings Delivered

Clean power flows, bills drop, and we keep it running at peak.

How We Work

## From Enquiry to Energised

A proven, single-window process, disciplined, transparent and on time at every step.

1

### Consultation & Site Survey

We assess your roof or land, study load patterns and shadow profile, and define the optimal system, free of cost.

2

#### Design & Proposal

Detailed engineering, energy-yield modelling, a transparent quotation and subsidy/ROI breakdown for your approval.

3

#### Procurement

Tier-1 modules, inverters and mounting structures sourced to ISO standards, quality controlled before dispatch.

4

#### Civil, Piling & Structures

Robust foundations, pile-driving, MMS erection and balance-of-system civil works built to last 25+ years.

5

#### Installation & Commissioning

Precision installation, DC/AC works, earthing, net-metering liaison and safety-compliant grid synchronisation.

6

#### O&M & Support

Performance monitoring, preventive maintenance and statutory compliance keep your plant at peak yield.

Why Go Solar

## The Smartest Investment a Business or Home Can Make

Electricity is one of the largest recurring costs for Indian industries, institutions and households, and grid tariffs only climb year after year. A well-engineered **solar power plant** turns that liability into a 25-year asset: it slashes your monthly bills from day one, protects you from tariff hikes, and typically pays for itself in just **3 to 5 years**. Everything after that is effectively free, clean power.

With falling module prices, accelerated depreciation for businesses, and the government's **PM Surya Ghar** subsidy for residential rooftops, there has never been a better time to switch. As an **ISO-certified, veteran-led solar EPC company**, Ingenieria (Arrays Ingenieria Pvt. Ltd.) makes the transition effortless, handling everything from feasibility and engineering to procurement, civil works, installation, net-metering and long-term maintenance.

### Built for Indian conditions

From the deserts of Rajasthan to the tea gardens of Assam, we engineer ground-mount and rooftop systems that withstand extreme heat, monsoon and dust, maximising generation across every season and terrain.

- Cut electricity bills by up to 90%
- 3–5 year payback, 25+ year asset life
- Government subsidy & accelerated depreciation

### A single, accountable partner

No juggling multiple vendors. Ingenieria delivers complete turnkey EPC under one roof, with the discipline, safety standards and on-time delivery our ex-servicemen leadership is known for, trusted by Tata Power Solar, Tata Steel, Tata Motors and more.

- Tier-1 modules & ISO-grade workmanship
- End-to-end approvals & net-metering
- Lifetime O&M & performance monitoring

FAQ

## Frequently Asked Questions

Everything you need to know about going solar with Ingenieria.

What does Ingenieria (Arrays Ingenieria Pvt. Ltd.) do?

We are a veteran-led, ISO 9001/14001/45001-certified **solar EPC company** operating Pan-India. We design and build ground-mount and rooftop solar power plants and handle pile foundations, civil works, chain-link fencing, grid commissioning and long-term operations & maintenance, from a single rooftop to 300 MW utility-scale parks.

How much does a solar power system cost in India?

As a guide, installed cost ranges from about **₹42,000–₹60,000 per kWp** depending on whether it is utility ground-mount, industrial, commercial or residential rooftop. Use our free Solar Savings Calculator for a personalised estimate including subsidy and payback.

Is there a government subsidy for solar?

Yes. Under the **PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana**, residential rooftop systems are eligible for a central subsidy of up to **₹78,000** (₹30,000/kW for the first 2 kW + ₹18,000 for the 3rd kW). Businesses can also claim **accelerated depreciation**. Our calculator factors the residential subsidy in automatically.

What is the payback period and how much can I save?

Most of our clients see a **payback of 3–5 years**, after which the system keeps generating largely free power for its 25+ year life, often delivering several times the investment in lifetime savings, plus a major cut in carbon emissions.

Should I choose ground-mount or rooftop solar?

**Rooftop solar** is ideal when you have unused roof space and want to offset on-site consumption. **Ground-mount solar** suits larger capacities and open land, delivering maximum generation. We assess your load, space and goals during a free site survey and recommend the optimal mix.

Do you handle approvals, net-metering and subsidy paperwork?

Yes, we manage the complete process: structural & shadow analysis, DISCOM liaison, net-metering applications, subsidy documentation, grid synchronisation and safety-compliant commissioning. It's true single-window, turnkey delivery.

Which areas of India do you serve?

We work **Pan-India**, from tea estates in Assam to industrial rooftops and utility-scale ground-mount plants, operated from our Greater Noida (UP) corporate office and Madhubani (Bihar) branch.

Why choose a veteran-led solar company?

Ingenieria is founded and run entirely by former military professionals. That means **discipline, meticulous planning, strict safety, and uncompromising on-time delivery** on every site, the same values that have earned us repeat trust from Tata Power Solar, Tata Steel, Tata Motors, Super Smelters and Jay Shree Tea.

Get In Touch

# Engineering a Greener Nation

Veteran-led. ISO-certified. Pan-India. The story of how military precision is powering India's clean-energy transition.

Who We Are

## Where Engineering Meets Resilience

**Ingenieria (Arrays Ingenieria Pvt. Ltd.)** is a renewable-energy EPC company founded in 2018 and run entirely by former military personnel. The name "Ingeniería" means engineering in Spanish, a fitting symbol of our commitment to precision, innovation and discipline in everything we build.

We design, engineer and deliver **ground-mount and rooftop solar power plants** across India, along with pile foundations, civil works, chain-link fencing, grid commissioning and long-term operations & maintenance. From a single rooftop to a 300 MW utility-scale solar park, we approach every project with the same steadfast focus on excellence, safety and sustainability.

Our ISO 9001, ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 certifications reflect an unwavering dedication to quality, environmental stewardship and occupational safety, and our partnerships with industry leaders such as **Tata Power Solar, Tata Steel, Tata Motors, DCM, Super Smelters and Jay Shree Tea** have established us as a trusted, emerging leader in renewable energy.

Inaugurated by the Chief Minister

## Koomber Solar Plant, Opened by the CM of Assam

Announced by the Chief Minister's Office, posted by MLA Kaushik Rai and reported by The Sentinel.

**1 Oct 2026**Koomber Tea Estate, Assam

Inaugurated by the Hon'ble Chief Minister of Assam

### Dr Himanta Biswa Sarma opens the 595 kWp solar plant we installed at Koomber Tea Estate

Part of the 3.11 MW Goodricke Tea Estates Solar Programme with Tata Power Renewable Energy and Sustvest, with Arrays Ingenieria as installation partner.

“Glad to see Arrays Ingenieria, an MSME spearheaded by ex-servicemen under Lt Gen AR Prasad (Retd), deliver critical renewable infrastructure with uncompromising military discipline.”

Shri Kaushik Rai, MLA, Lakhipur, on X and Facebook

“It is particularly encouraging to witness Arrays Ingenieria, an MSME led by ex-servicemen under the stewardship of Lt. Gen. A.R. Prasad (Retd.), translating its expertise, precision and institutional discipline into critical renewable-energy infrastructure.”

Shri Rajdeep Goala, MLA, Udharbond, on X and Facebook

### For homes & businesses

Whether you want to cut a soaring household bill or take an entire factory off the grid in daytime, we right-size the system to your load, roof or land, and budget. Residential clients benefit from the PM Surya Ghar subsidy; commercial and industrial clients gain from accelerated depreciation and rapid 3–5 year paybacks.

### For institutions & government

We deliver to the documentation, safety and compliance standards public projects demand, from schools and hospitals to large PSU and utility-scale parks such as the 300 MW SECI project at Koppal. Our ex-servicemen team is built for exactly this kind of disciplined, accountable execution.

Solar EPC Service

# Ground-Mount Solar

Utility and industrial-scale ground-mount solar power plants - engineered for maximum generation and built to endure India's harshest terrains, from the deserts of Rajasthan to the tea gardens of Assam.

What We Do

## Ground-Mount Solar

Ground-mount solar is where Ingenieria's engineering pedigree truly shows. We handle the entire lifecycle - geo-technical survey, optimal tilt and row-spacing design, robust module mounting structures (MMS), DC/AC works and grid synchronisation - delivering plants that generate more, for longer.

Because our teams are drawn entirely from the armed forces, every site runs with military discipline: meticulous planning, strict safety protocols and uncompromising quality control at each milestone.

### Our Capabilities

- Site survey, soil testing & energy-yield modelling
- Hot-dip galvanised module mounting structures
- String & central inverter configurations
- DC/AC cabling, earthing & lightning protection
- Grid synchronisation & commissioning
- Performance testing & handover

### Proven Experience

We have delivered large-scale ground-mount installations including the **10 MW DCM Hisar** project in Haryana, **1 MW Jayshree Tea Estate** (Sonari, Assam) under a Tata Power EPC contract, **535 kWp Towkok** and **500 kWp Manjushree** tea-estate plants, and ground-mount works for **Tata Steel, Noamundi**.

#### At a Glance

Typical capacity: **100 kWp - 300 MW**

Structures: **HDG MMS, pile / pre-cast**

Scope: **EPC & balance-of-system**

Sectors: **Industrial, tea estates, utilities**

#### Planning a project?

Talk to our veteran-led team for a free, no-obligation consultation.

[Get a Free Quote](https://arraysingenieria.com/#contact)

FAQ

## Frequently Asked Questions

How much land is needed for a ground-mount solar plant?

Roughly 4 to 5 acres per MW, depending on module efficiency and layout. Ingenieria optimises tilt and row spacing to maximise generation on the available land.

What foundation types do you use for ground-mount solar?

Driven or rammed piles, bored piles, or pre-cast and RCC pedestals, selected from a site-specific geo-technical survey to suit your soil and wind loads.

What ground-mount capacities has Ingenieria delivered?

From sub-megawatt plants to pile foundations for the 300 MW SECI park at Koppal, plus the 10 MW DCM Hisar project and multiple tea-estate plants across Assam.

Solar EPC Service

# Rooftop Solar

On-grid rooftop solar PV for factories, institutions and businesses - converting unused roof space into a clean, reliable and bill-slashing power asset.

What We Do

## Rooftop Solar

From RCC rooftops to large industrial metal sheds, Ingenieria engineers rooftop systems that maximise generation while protecting your roof's integrity. We manage structural assessment, leak-proof mounting, net-metering liaison and safe commissioning end to end.

Every installation is executed with rigorous safety standards and statutory compliance - the same discipline our clients across India have come to expect and appreciate.

### Our Capabilities

- Structural & shadow analysis
- Leak-proof ballasted & penetration mounts
- Net-metering & DISCOM liaison
- Tier-1 modules & smart inverters
- Walkways, earthing & safety systems
- Generation monitoring & reporting

### Proven Experience

Our rooftop portfolio includes a **1711.66 kWp on-grid rooftop** project in Assam, the **1980.3 kWp Super Smelters** industrial plant in Asansol (with Tata Power Solar), rooftop solar at **Balaji Action Tesa, Sitarganj**, and an RCC rooftop system for **Bharat Petroleum** in Gurugram.

#### At a Glance

Typical capacity: **10 kWp - 2 MWp**

Roof types: **RCC & metal sheet**

Connection: **On-grid / net-metered**

Sectors: **Industrial, fuel retail, institutional**

#### Planning a project?

Talk to our veteran-led team for a free, no-obligation consultation.

[Get a Free Quote](https://arraysingenieria.com/#contact)

FAQ

## Frequently Asked Questions

Will rooftop solar damage my roof?

No. We use leak-proof, structurally engineered mounting for both RCC and metal-sheet roofs, backed by load and shadow analysis to protect your roof's integrity.

What is net-metering and do you handle it?

Surplus solar power is exported to the grid and credited against your bill. Ingenieria manages the entire DISCOM net-metering application and approval process for you.

What size rooftop solar system can you install?

From 10 kWp for homes and shops to multi-megawatt industrial rooftops, such as the 1980 kWp Super Smelters and 1711 kWp Assam on-grid plants.

Civil Service

# Pile Foundation & Piling

Specialist pile-foundation and piling works - the bedrock of every reliable ground-mount solar plant, executed with precision-engineered rigs and rigorous load testing.

What We Do

## Pile Foundation & Piling

Foundations make or break a solar plant's 25-year life. Ingenieria deploys modern hydraulic piling rigs and proven methodologies - driven, bored and pre-cast pile foundations - engineered to site-specific soil conditions and pull-out load requirements.

Our piling credentials include some of the largest solar sites in the country, delivered safely and on schedule even under demanding ground conditions.

### Our Capabilities

- Geo-technical investigation & pile design
- Driven, bored & pre-cast pile foundations
- Hydraulic rig piling at scale
- Pull-out & load testing
- Pile-cap & pedestal civil works
- Survey, alignment & QA

### Proven Experience

We executed pile-foundation works for the **300 MW SECI project at Koppal, Karnataka** and piling & civil works for the **5.5 MW Tata Motors (TML)** project in Jamshedpur, alongside piling for projects in Bihar and beyond.

#### At a Glance

Largest site: **300 MW (SECI, Koppal)**

Pile types: **Driven / bored / pre-cast**

Equipment: **Hydraulic piling rigs**

QA: **Load & pull-out tested**

#### Planning a project?

Talk to our veteran-led team for a free, no-obligation consultation.

[Get a Free Quote](https://arraysingenieria.com/#contact)

FAQ

## Frequently Asked Questions

What solar piling methods do you offer?

Driven, bored and pre-cast pile foundations using modern hydraulic rigs, engineered to site soil conditions and pull-out load requirements.

What is your largest piling project?

Pile-foundation works for the 300 MW SECI solar park at Koppal, Karnataka, and piling and civil works for the 5.5 MW Tata Motors project in Jamshedpur.

Do you carry out pile load testing?

Yes, pull-out and load testing is performed to verify foundation integrity before mounting structures are installed.

# Civil Works & Fencing

Robust civil infrastructure for solar sites - pre-cast boundary walls, RCC works and secure chain-link fencing that protect and complete every installation.

What We Do

## Civil Works & Fencing

A solar plant is only as secure as its perimeter and as durable as its civil works. Ingenieria delivers supply, civil work and erection of chain-link fencing, pre-cast and cast-in-situ boundary walls, foundations, drains and roads - engineered for longevity and security.

Our civil teams bring the same discipline and attention to detail that defines our solar EPC work, ensuring every site is safe, compliant and built to last.

### Our Capabilities

- Supply & erection of chain-link fencing
- Pre-cast & RCC boundary walls
- Foundations, pedestals & pile caps
- Internal roads, drains & civil BOS
- Site grading & earthworks
- Security infrastructure

### Proven Experience

Our civil scope includes supply, civil work and erection of chain-link fencing for the **14.36 MW YIAPL Solar Power Project** in Uttar Pradesh, a **pre-cast boundary wall for Tata Motors, Jamshedpur**, and chain-link fencing & civil works in **Madhepura, Bihar**.

#### At a Glance

Legal

# Privacy Policy

What we collect through our contact form, why, who processes it, how long we keep it, your rights under India's DPDP Act, the GDPR and the CCPA, and our Grievance Officer.

Last updated: 11 October 2026

## 1. Who we are

This website is run by **Arrays Ingenieria Pvt. Ltd.** ("Ingenieria", "we", "us"), CIN U45309DL2018PTC340544, corporate office: Arrays Ingenieria Pvt. Ltd., A-27 NSG Society, Greater Noida, Uttar Pradesh 201310, India. We decide how the personal data described here is used, so we are its data fiduciary under India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 (DPDP Act) and its controller under the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR). Contact: [arraysingenieria@gmail.com](mailto:arraysingenieria@gmail.com).

## 2. What we collect

We collect personal data only when you choose to contact us. Our contact form asks for:

- **Name**, **phone number** and **email address** (required), so we can reply;
- **Project type** and **location** (optional), so we can understand your site;
- **Message** (optional): whatever you choose to tell us about your requirement.

Our [free solar quote](https://arraysingenieria.com/free-solar-quote/) form also asks about your project, so we can prepare a proposal: who the plant is for, the services you need, how you would like to pay for it, the site's state, city, type and area, your monthly electricity bill and tariff, grid connection, sanctioned load and diesel generators, when you want to start, how it will be funded, your role, your company, how and when you prefer to be contacted, and how you heard about us. It also records which website or campaign link brought you to the form (for example a Google search), and an indicative plant size and savings estimate worked out in your browser from your bill. On the quote form the required answers are: who the plant is for; at least one service; the state and city or district of the site; when you want to start; and your name, phone and email. For a new solar plant we also require how you would like to pay for it and your monthly electricity bill, because we cannot size a plant or estimate savings without them. For operation and maintenance, piling, civil or installation-only requests we do not ask for your bill or payment choice; we ask instead for a short description of the plant and the work. Everything else on the form is optional.

If you email us directly, we receive your email address and whatever your email contains. We do not run user accounts, advertising or tracking of individuals. We use Cloudflare Web Analytics to count page visits in aggregate; it sets no cookies and does not identify you. Like every website host, our host keeps short-lived technical server logs (such as IP address, browser type and the page requested) to deliver the site and keep it secure.

## 3. Why we use it

We use your details **only to answer your enquiry**: to reply, discuss your project and, if you ask, prepare a quotation. We rely on the consent you give by submitting the form (DPDP Act section 6; GDPR article 6(1)(a)) and, where you ask for a quote, on taking steps at your request before a contract (GDPR article 6(1)(b)). Our quote form gives each request a simple label, Hot, Warm or Cold, worked out in your browser from your monthly bill, your start timeline, your role and the type of property, so that our team can decide whom to call first. The label is sent with your request. It is never used to refuse a quote or to make any decision with legal or similarly significant effect on you: every enquiry is answered by a person. We make no other automated decisions and build no other profiles.

## 4. Who processes it for us

We use three service providers (data processors). Each handles your data only to provide its service to us:

- **FormSubmit** (formsubmit.co) receives what you type into the contact form and the free solar quote form and forwards it to our mailbox. See the [FormSubmit privacy policy](https://formsubmit.co/privacy.pdf).
- **Google** (Gmail) hosts our mailbox, [arraysingenieria@gmail.com](mailto:arraysingenieria@gmail.com), where enquiries are stored.
- **Cloudflare** (Cloudflare Pages) hosts and delivers this website and keeps the technical server logs described above. See the [Cloudflare privacy policy](https://www.cloudflare.com/privacypolicy/).

These providers may process data on servers outside India, including in the United States, under their own safeguards. We share your data with no one else, except where the law requires it, or where you ask us to: if you choose the pay-per-unit (OPEX) option on the quote form and tell us you want an introduction, we may pass your contact and project details to a solar developer we build for, only with your permission.

## 5. Cookies and embedded posts

**Arrays Ingenieria itself sets no cookies** and uses no advertising or tracking of its own. Visit counts come from [Cloudflare Web Analytics](https://www.cloudflare.com/web-analytics/), which works without cookies and without identifying visitors. Our fonts, images and scripts are served from our own site.

Our [News & Media](https://arraysingenieria.com/recognition/) page and the [Koomber case study](https://arraysingenieria.com/project-koomber-tea-estate-595kwp-solar-cm-inauguration/) show original posts from **X (Twitter), Facebook and Instagram**. When you scroll to them, your browser loads each post directly from that platform, which may set its own cookies and receive your IP address under its own privacy policy ([X](https://x.com/en/privacy), [Facebook and Instagram](https://www.facebook.com/privacy/policy/)). News videos from YouTube load only when you press play, from YouTube's privacy-enhanced youtube-nocookie.com player. You can block third-party cookies in your browser settings; the posts will then still appear as text cards with links to the originals.

## 6. How long we keep it

We keep an enquiry for as long as we need it to respond and, if a project follows, for the life of that project. Enquiries that do not lead to a project are deleted within 24 months of our last contact with you. Records that the law requires us to keep longer, such as tax and accounting records for contracts, are kept for the period the law sets. You can ask us to delete your enquiry at any time (see section 8).

## 7. No sale, no sharing, no marketing lists

**We never sell your personal data, and we never share it for advertising**, including "selling" or "sharing" as defined in the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA, as amended by the CPRA). Submitting the contact form **never subscribes you to a newsletter or marketing list**: we use your details only to reply to the enquiry you sent.

## 8. Your rights

Wherever you are, you can ask us to:

- tell you what personal data we hold about you and how we use it (access / right to know);
- correct or complete it;
- delete it (erasure);
- stop using it, by withdrawing your consent at any time (this does not affect anything we did before you withdrew it);
- under the DPDP Act, nominate someone to exercise your rights if you die or become incapacitated.

Email [arraysingenieria@gmail.com](mailto:arraysingenieria@gmail.com) with your request. We will not treat you differently for using any of these rights. If you are in the EU or UK you may also complain to your data protection authority; in India you may approach the Data Protection Board of India after using our grievance process below.

## 9. Security and children

The site is served only over encrypted HTTPS, and access to our mailbox is restricted to our team. No method of transmission or storage is completely secure, but we take reasonable steps to protect your data. This website is meant for businesses and adults; we do not knowingly collect data from anyone under 18.

## 10. Grievance Officer

Under the Information Technology Act, 2000, the rules made under it, and the DPDP Act, you can raise any concern or complaint about how we handle your personal data with our Grievance Officer:

**Grievance Officer, Arrays Ingenieria Pvt. Ltd.**
Email: [arraysingenieria@gmail.com](mailto:arraysingenieria@gmail.com)

We will acknowledge your complaint and **resolve it within 30 days** of receiving it.

## 11. Changes to this policy

If we change how we handle personal data, we will update this page and the date at the top.

CAPEX Solar EPC

# Own Your Solar Plant: CAPEX Solar EPC

You invest once and own the plant outright. We design it, supply it, build it and commission it, and every unit it generates is yours.

[Request a CAPEX Proposal](https://arraysingenieria.com/free-solar-quote/?service=capex) See a plant our client owns

What CAPEX Means

## Your plant, your savings, from day one

Under the **CAPEX model** your organisation pays for the solar plant and owns it. There is no long-term power purchase agreement and no per-unit tariff to a developer: the electricity the plant produces replaces power you would otherwise buy from the grid or from diesel generators.

Arrays Ingenieria delivers CAPEX plants end to end. We are an **installation, EPC and civil company**: we do not manufacture modules or inverters, so we are free to specify **Tier-1 equipment** from established manufacturers, or the makes your engineers or lead EPC have approved, and put all our effort into building the plant properly.

### What you get

- Site survey, load study and system design
- Tier-1 modules, inverters and balance-of-system equipment
- Civil works as the site needs: pile foundations, RCC, boundary walls and fencing
- Mechanical and electrical installation, earthing and lightning protection
- Support with net-metering, DISCOM and Electrical Inspector (CEIG) approvals, as agreed in the contract scope, plus testing and commissioning
- Handover documentation, and O&M support if you want it

### Why businesses choose CAPEX

Owning the plant often gives the lowest lifetime cost of power, because no developer margin is built into a tariff. The real result depends on your finance cost, tariff, roof or land, and how well the plant is maintained. A business that owns the plant may also claim **accelerated depreciation** under the Income Tax Act, which lowers tax in the early years; check the current rate with your tax adviser.

## At a glance

Model: **CAPEX: you own the plant**

We deliver: **Design, supply, I&C, civil**

Equipment: **Tier-1, not own-brand**

Plants: **Rooftop & ground-mount**

Assurance: **ISO 9001, 14001, 45001**

## Thinking of owning your plant?

Talk to our veteran-led team for a free, no-obligation consultation.

[Request a CAPEX Proposal](https://arraysingenieria.com/free-solar-quote/?service=capex)

CAPEX vs OPEX

## Which Model Suits You?

An honest comparison. We build on the CAPEX model; if you prefer OPEX, the developer you sign with can still engage us to build the plant.

 |  | CAPEX (you own) | OPEX / RESCO (developer owns) |
| --- | --- | --- |
  | Upfront investment | You pay for the plant | None; the developer invests |
 | Who owns the plant | You, from commissioning | The developer, for the contract term |
 | What you pay afterwards | No per-unit tariff; you bear upkeep, insurance and any loan repayments | A per-unit tariff for many years |
 | Lifetime savings | Often higher: savings are not shared with a developer, but depend on finance and upkeep | Usually lower: the tariff includes the developer's return |
 | Tax benefit | Accelerated depreciation for businesses | Goes to the developer |
 | Best for | Organisations with capital or bank finance | Organisations that cannot invest upfront |
 | Arrays Ingenieria's role | Your EPC contractor, end to end | Installation & EPC partner to the developer |

How It Works

## From Survey to Switch-On

- 1

**Site survey & load study**

We study your roof or land, your load profile, your grid connection and any diesel generators.

- 2

**Design & proposal**

A system design, bill of quantities and a clear scope of work, so you know exactly what you are paying for.

- 3

**Procurement**

Tier-1 modules, inverters and balance-of-system equipment, to our specification or your approved makes.

- 4

**Civil & installation**

Piling or roof works, structures, modules, cabling, earthing and lightning protection, run by ex-servicemen site teams.

- 5

**Approvals & commissioning**

Net-metering and DISCOM approvals, testing, grid synchronisation and commissioning.

- 6

**Handover & support**

As-built documents and training for your team, with O&M support available.

Ownership

## Under CAPEX, You Own Everything

You pay Arrays Ingenieria to build the plant. From commissioning, it is yours.

 | Item | Who owns it under CAPEX |
| --- | --- |
  | The solar plant: modules, inverters, structures, cabling | You |
 | Every unit of electricity it generates | You: used on site or exported to the grid |
 | The savings on your power and diesel bills | You, for the life of the plant |
 | Tax benefit (accelerated depreciation, for businesses) | You |
 | Manufacturers' equipment warranties | Issued for your plant, handed over to you |
 | The roof or land | Stays yours; nothing is leased to anyone |
 | Upkeep after handover | Your responsibility; our O&M service is optional |
 | Arrays Ingenieria | Paid once to design, supply, build and commission the plant; owns nothing in it |

Questions

## CAPEX Solar FAQ

Do you offer OPEX, RESCO or zero-investment solar?

No. We build plants that our clients own. If you want an OPEX arrangement, the developer that finances the plant can engage us as its installation and EPC partner, as Tata Power Renewable Energy and Sustvest have done.

Do you manufacture the panels and inverters?

No. We are an installation, EPC and civil company. We specify Tier-1 equipment from established manufacturers, or the makes your engineers approve.

Can you work with our own engineers or consultant?

Yes. We regularly build to specifications and approved makes set by the client or the lead EPC, such as Tata Power.

Installation & Commissioning

# Solar Installation & Commissioning (I&C)

Veteran-led site teams that build and commission solar plants for EPC companies, developers and plant owners, to your design and your schedule.

What I&C Covers

## Your design, built and switched on

**Installation & commissioning (I&C)** is the on-site work of turning a solar design and a delivery of equipment into a working, grid-connected plant. It is where most of the risk in a project sits: safety, quality, schedule and the dozens of trades that have to work in sequence.

This is the heart of what Arrays Ingenieria does. Our site teams are led by ex-servicemen who run every job with military discipline, and we work to the specifications, approved makes and quality plans of the EPC or developer we build for.

### Scope we take on

- Pile foundations and module mounting structures
- Module installation
- DC and AC cabling, cable trays and conduits
- Inverters, ACDB/DCDB and LT panels
- Earthing and lightning protection
- Module cleaning systems
- DG synchronisation for sites with diesel generators
- Testing, grid synchronisation and commissioning
- Net-metering and DISCOM approvals when required

### Who we build for

**EPC companies** that need a dependable execution partner: Tata Power has engaged us for piling, civil works and installation from Karnataka to Assam. **Solar developers** running OPEX or RESCO programmes: Sustvest appointed us for the installation and commissioning of 1711.66 kWp in Assam. And **plant owners** who buy their own equipment and want it built properly.

## At a glance

Service: **Installation & commissioning**

Clients: **EPCs, developers, owners**

Works to: **Your design & approved makes**

Coverage: **Pan-India**

Safety: **ISO 45001:2018**

## Need an I&C partner?

How We Run a Site

## Built the Military Way

- 1

**Mobilisation**

Site survey, method statements, safety plan and a day-by-day programme agreed with you.

**Foundations & structures**

Piling or roof works and module mounting structures, surveyed and checked for level and alignment.

- 3

**Modules & electrical**

Module installation, DC and AC cabling, inverters, boards, earthing and lightning protection.

**Inspection**

Quality checks at every stage, to your inspection and test plan.

- 5

**Testing & commissioning**

Pre-commissioning tests, grid synchronisation and performance checks.

- 6

**Handover**

As-built documents, test reports and a clean, safe site.

Solar for Tea Estates

# Solar Power for Assam's Tea Gardens

19 on-grid solar plants and counting, for estates of Jay Shree Tea (BK Birla Group) and Goodricke Group.

Tea-Estate Solar

## Clean power for the tea industry

Tea estates draw heavy power in the processing season, much of it in daylight hours, and many rely on diesel generators when the grid fails. A ground-mount solar plant on estate land cuts both grid bills and diesel.

Arrays Ingenieria has become one of the most active solar builders in Assam's tea gardens. As reported in September 2026, the company has installed **19 on-grid solar plants** in the state's tea estates, from Jay Shree Tea's first-ever renewable project at Towkok and Manjushree to the Goodricke estates at Orangajuli and Barpatra.

### What tea estates need, and what we handle

- Ground-mount plants on estate land, on pile foundations
- Synchronisation with the estate's diesel generators
- Net-metering and approvals with APDCL
- Earthing and lightning protection for Assam's storms
- Module cleaning systems for easy washing
- Plants built on the CAPEX model, or as partner to programmes run by Tata Power Renewable Energy and Sustvest

### Estates we have powered

[Towkok (535 kWp) and Manjushree (500 kWp)](https://arraysingenieria.com/project-jayshree-tea-1mw-solar-assam/) for Jay Shree Tea; the Dewan, Labac and Burtoll gardens of Jay Shree Tea's Dewan Group; [Orangajuli (450 kW)](https://arraysingenieria.com/project-orangajuli-tea-estate-450kw-solar/) and [Barpatra (230 kW)](https://arraysingenieria.com/project-barpatra-tea-estate-230kw-solar/) for Goodricke; and Kakajan Tea Estate for Amalgamated Plantations. Most recently, the [595 kWp plant at Koomber Tea Estate](https://arraysingenieria.com/project-koomber-tea-estate-595kwp-solar-cm-inauguration/) was inaugurated by the Chief Minister of Assam on 1 October 2026.

## At a glance

Plants in Assam: **19 on-grid (Sep 2026)**

Clients: **Jay Shree Tea, Goodricke**

Plant type: **Ground-mount, on-grid**

Extras: **DG sync, net-metering**

Region: **Assam & the North-East**

The Chief Minister of Assam cuts the ribbon at the 595 kWp Koomber Tea Estate solar plant installed by Arrays Ingenieria

The inauguration ceremony at the Koomber Tea Estate 595 kWp solar plant, 1 October 2026, Arrays Ingenieria installation partner

Why It Matters

## Driving the PM's Panchamrit and Assam's green-energy goals

Tea processing is energy-intensive. Every estate that swaps grid and diesel power for solar cuts fossil-fuel use, contributing to Prime Minister Narendra Modi's "Panchamrit" climate commitments announced at COP26: 500 GW of non-fossil capacity and half of India's energy needs from renewables by 2030, and net zero by 2070.

It also advances Assam Chief Minister Dr Himanta Biswa Sarma's target of 6,000 MW of installed green-energy capacity by 2030, and his decision to let tea gardens use up to 5% of their land for solar. Sustainable innovation and clean energy can drive the next chapter of Assam's economic growth story.

Sources: [PM's national statement at COP26, PIB, 1 Nov 2021](https://pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=1768712); [Himanta Biswa Sarma, 22 Sep 2026](https://himantabiswa.substack.com/p/rewriting-assams-energy-future).

[Panchamrit & Solar Schemes](https://arraysingenieria.com/solar-schemes-india/#panchamrit)

Frequently Asked Questions

# Solar EPC, Answered

What we do, how the CAPEX model works, what installation & commissioning covers, and how to start a project with us.

What does Arrays Ingenieria do?

Arrays Ingenieria is a veteran-led solar contractor. We do three things: installation & commissioning (I&C) of solar plants, complete EPC (engineering, procurement and construction), and all the civil works a plant needs, from pile foundations to boundary walls and fencing. We work on the CAPEX model, so the plant belongs to our client.

Is Arrays Ingenieria (Ingenieria) an ex-servicemen-led company?

Yes. Arrays Ingenieria Pvt. Ltd., known as Ingenieria, is an ex-servicemen-led MSME founded in 2018 by Lt. Gen. Ashish Ranjan Prasad (Retd), its Chief Executive Officer. Veterans lead its project teams under the motto "Olive Green to Go Green".

Did Arrays Ingenieria build the Koomber Tea Estate solar plant inaugurated by the Chief Minister of Assam?

Yes. Arrays Ingenieria was the installation partner for the 595 kWp ground-mounted, on-grid solar plant at Koomber Tea Estate, Cachar, inaugurated by Chief Minister Dr Himanta Biswa Sarma on 1 October 2026. It is part of the 3.11 MW Goodricke Tea Estates Solar Programme developed by Tata Power Renewable Energy and Sustvest.

Which tea-estate solar plants did Arrays Ingenieria complete in 2026?

Under the 3.11 MW Goodricke Tea Estates Solar Programme: Orangajuli Tea Garden, Udalguri (450 kWp, inaugurated 4 September 2026), Borpatra Tea Estate, Sivasagar (230 kWp, inaugurated 25 September 2026) and Koomber Tea Estate, Cachar (595 kWp, inaugurated by the Chief Minister on 1 October 2026).

Do you manufacture solar panels or inverters?

No. We are an installation, EPC and civil company, not a manufacturer. We source Tier-1 modules, inverters and balance-of-system equipment from established manufacturers, or use the makes approved by our client or the lead EPC, such as Tata Power-approved makes.

What is the CAPEX model for solar?

Under CAPEX you pay for the plant and own it from day one. We design, supply and build it; every unit it generates is yours, and there is no long-term power purchase agreement. Businesses that own the plant may also claim accelerated depreciation under the Income Tax Act; check the current rate with your tax adviser.

Do you offer OPEX, RESCO or zero-investment solar?

No, we do not finance or own plants. If your organisation prefers an OPEX or RESCO arrangement, the developer that finances the plant can engage us as its installation and EPC partner, as Tata Power Renewable Energy and Sustvest have done for tea estates in Assam.

What is the difference between CAPEX and OPEX solar?

With CAPEX you invest upfront, own the plant and keep all the savings. With OPEX or RESCO a developer invests and owns the plant, and you buy its power at an agreed tariff for many years. CAPEX usually gives the highest lifetime savings; OPEX avoids the upfront cost.

What does solar installation & commissioning (I&C) include?

I&C covers everything on site after the design and equipment are fixed: mounting structures, module installation, DC and AC cabling, inverters and distribution boards, earthing and lightning protection, testing, grid synchronisation and commissioning.

Do you work as a subcontractor for EPC companies and developers?

Yes, it is a large part of our work. Tata Power has engaged us for pile foundations on the 300 MW SECI project at Koppal, civil works on the 10 MW DCM Textile plant in Hisar and piling and civil works for the 5.5 MW Tata Motors plant in Jamshedpur, and Sustvest for the installation and commissioning of 1711.66 kWp in Assam.

What civil works do you carry out for solar plants?

Pile foundations for module mounting structures, RCC works, pre-cast boundary walls, chain-link fencing, earthing with its civil work, and cable trays and conduits with their supports.

Can a solar plant work alongside our diesel generators?

Yes. At Jay Shree Tea's Towkok and Manjushree estates the scope included synchronising each solar plant with two DG sets, so the estates can run solar and generators together.

Do you handle net-metering and DISCOM approvals?

Yes. At Borpatra Tea Estate in Assam we obtained the net-metering and statutory approvals from APDCL, including its technical inspections, so the plant could start on schedule.

How many tea-estate solar plants have you built?

As reported in September 2026, Arrays Ingenieria has installed 19 on-grid solar plants in Assam's tea gardens, for estates including those of Jay Shree Tea (BK Birla Group) and Goodricke Group.

Where in India do you work?

Across India. Our projects span Assam, West Bengal, Bihar, Jharkhand, Uttar Pradesh, Uttarakhand, Haryana and Karnataka. Our corporate office is in Greater Noida, Uttar Pradesh, with a branch office in Madhubani, Bihar.

Who runs Arrays Ingenieria?

The company was founded in 2018 by Lt. Gen. Ashish Ranjan Prasad (Retd), AVSM, VSM, ADC, former Signal Officer-in-Chief of the Indian Army, and is run by ex-servicemen who bring military discipline, safety and timeliness to every site.

Which certifications do you hold?

We are ISO 9001:2015 (quality), ISO 14001:2015 (environment) and ISO 45001:2018 (occupational health & safety) certified, and a registered MSME (Udyam UDYAM-DL-03-0023905).

What is the GST rate on solar panels in 2026?

5%. The 56th GST Council cut GST on solar cells, modules and other renewable-energy devices from 12% to 5% with effect from 22 September 2025. How GST applies to a full EPC contract depends on the contract, so confirm with your tax adviser.

What is ALMM List-II and does it affect my solar project?

ALMM List-II lists approved solar PV cell manufacturers. From 1 June 2026, projects covered by MNRE's ALMM order must use modules from List-I that are made with cells from List-II. We specify the listed makes each project needs.

How do I contact Arrays Ingenieria?

Email arraysingenieria@gmail.com or use the form on the contact page. Tell us the site location, roof or land area and your monthly electricity use, and an engineer will get back to you.

How do I get a quote?

Send us your site location, the type of plant (rooftop or ground-mount), the approximate capacity or your monthly electricity bill, and whether you need full EPC, I&C only or civil works only. Use the contact form or email arraysingenieria@gmail.com.

[Ask Us Anything](https://arraysingenieria.com/contact/)[Solar Glossary](https://arraysingenieria.com/solar-glossary/)

Solar Glossary

# Solar Terms, in Plain English

The words you will meet when planning a solar plant, from CAPEX and I&C to kWp and net metering.

## A

Accelerated depreciation

A tax benefit that lets a business that owns a solar plant write off its cost faster than normal assets, reducing taxable income in the early years. Available under the CAPEX model.

ACDB / DCDB

AC and DC distribution boards: the enclosures that house the fuses, isolators and surge protection between the modules, the inverters and the grid connection.

ALMM

Approved List of Models and Manufacturers: the list of solar modules approved by India's Ministry of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE) for use in government-linked projects.

ALMM List-II

MNRE's approved list of solar PV cell manufacturers. From 1 June 2026, projects covered by the ALMM order must use List-I modules made with List-II cells.

## B

Balance of system (BOS)

Everything in a solar plant except the modules: mounting structures, inverters, cables, distribution boards, earthing, lightning protection and monitoring.

Bifacial module

A solar module that generates power from both sides, using light reflected from the ground onto its rear face.

## C

CAPEX model

The owner pays for the solar plant upfront and owns it outright, keeping all the savings. Arrays Ingenieria builds plants on this model.

Commissioning

The final stage of a project: testing every component, synchronising the plant with the grid and handing it over as ready to generate.

CUF (capacity utilisation factor)

The energy a plant actually generates in a year as a percentage of what it would generate running at full capacity all year.

## D

DCR (domestic content requirement)

A rule in some government schemes that modules and cells must be made in India.

DG synchronisation

Controls that let a solar plant run alongside diesel generators safely, reducing fuel use without back-feeding the generators.

## E

Earthing

Connecting the plant's metal structures and electrical equipment to the ground so that fault currents and lightning are carried safely away.

EPC

Engineering, procurement and construction: a single contract covering the design, equipment purchase and building of the whole plant.

Ex-servicemen-led MSME

A micro, small or medium enterprise run by former members of the armed forces. Arrays Ingenieria is one, founded by Lt. Gen. A.R. Prasad (Retd).

## F

Financial closure

The point at which a project's funding (equity and loans) is fully tied up, so construction can start. PM-KUSUM Component A and C projects must reach it by 30 November 2026.

## G

Grid-connected (on-grid) system

A solar plant connected to the utility grid, which can draw from or export to the grid; the most common type for businesses.

Ground-mount solar

Modules installed on structures fixed to the ground, typically on pile foundations; used for tea estates, industrial land and utility parks.

Group captive

An arrangement where consumers take an ownership stake in an off-site solar plant and draw its power under captive-generation rules.

## I

I&C (installation & commissioning)

The on-site work of building a solar plant to an agreed design and bringing it into operation: structures, modules, cabling, inverters, earthing, testing and commissioning.

Inverter

The equipment that converts the direct current (DC) from the modules into alternating current (AC) for use on site or export to the grid.

## K

kWp / MWp

Kilowatt-peak and megawatt-peak: the rated DC output of a solar plant under standard test conditions. 1 MWp = 1,000 kWp.

## L

Lightning arrestor

A device that intercepts lightning strikes and conducts them safely to earth, protecting modules and equipment.

## M

MMS (module mounting structure)

The steel or aluminium frame that holds the modules at the designed tilt and orientation.

Module cleaning system

A pipe network with taps or nozzles across the plant so that modules can be washed regularly, recovering output lost to dust (soiling).

## N

Net metering

A billing arrangement where the power a solar plant exports to the grid is offset against the power drawn from it.

## O

OPEX / RESCO model

A developer (a renewable energy service company) finances and owns the plant, and the site owner buys its power at an agreed tariff. Arrays Ingenieria works as I&C or EPC partner to such developers.

## P

Panchamrit

The five climate commitments India announced at COP26 in 2021, including 500 GW of non-fossil capacity by 2030 and net zero by 2070.

Performance ratio (PR)

Actual energy generated divided by the theoretical energy available from the sunlight; a measure of how well a plant is built and maintained.

Pile foundation

A steel or concrete pile driven or cast into the ground to anchor the module mounting structures of a ground-mount plant.

PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana

The central government scheme that subsidises rooftop solar for homes.

Puja (commissioning ceremony)

A traditional prayer held at a new plant, as at the inverters of the Borpatra Tea Estate solar plant at its inauguration in September 2026.

## R

Rooftop solar

Modules installed on a building's RCC or metal-sheet roof, turning unused roof space into a power source.

## S

SCADA / remote monitoring

Systems that record a plant's generation and faults in real time and make them visible remotely.

## T

Tier-1 module

A module from a large, bankable manufacturer with an established production and financing track record.

TOPCon

Tunnel oxide passivated contact: a high-efficiency solar cell technology now common in new modules.

[Read the FAQ](https://arraysingenieria.com/faq/)[Solar Guides](https://arraysingenieria.com/insights/)

Source: https://arraysingenieria.com/ex-servicemen-led-msme/

Ex-Servicemen-Led MSME

# From Olive Green to Go Green

Arrays Ingenieria is an Udyam-registered MSME founded and led by veterans of the Indian Armed Forces. Building India's solar plants is our second innings of national service.

Who We Are

## A veteran-led MSME, building India's solar plants

Arrays Ingenieria was founded in 2018 by **Lieutenant General Ashish Ranjan Prasad (Retd)**, former Signal Officer-in-Chief of the Indian Army, after nearly four decades of military service. He set it up to give fellow veterans a **second innings**: a new mission, respectable work and a way to keep serving the nation.

The press describes us the same way. Hub Network calls the company "an Ex-Servicemen-led MSME"; The Sentinel writes of "a disciplined, mission-driven transition from OG (Olive Green-the military uniform) to GG (Go Green-renewable energy)".

Under our organisational motto **"Olive Green to Go Green"**, we bring military-grade discipline and engineering precision to deploying critical clean-energy infrastructure. For our team of veterans, working in renewable energy is a **"second innings of national service"**, contributing directly to sustainable nation-building, and to India's [Panchamrit](https://arraysingenieria.com/solar-schemes-india/#panchamrit) climate commitments.

Today we build solar plants across India: installation & commissioning, full EPC and all civil works, on the CAPEX model, for clients from [Tata Power and Jay Shree Tea to Goodricke and Sustvest](https://arraysingenieria.com/clients/).

Solar Schemes & Policies

# Government Solar Schemes in India

What the Government of India and the states offer for solar in 2026, and what the country's leaders have said, with every figure linked to its official source.

India's Solar Push

## The National Picture

Figures from PIB and MNRE data, each linked to its source. Updated October 2026.

[500  GWNon-fossil capacity target for 2030: the first of the Prime Minister's Panchamrit commitments at COP26Source: PIB](https://pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=1768712)[283.46  GWNon-fossil capacity installed in India as on 31 March 2026Source: PIB](https://pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=2250039)[50 %Share of India's installed power capacity from non-fossil sources, reached June 2025Source: PIB](https://pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=2250039)[164.59  GWSolar capacity installed in India as on 31 July 2026 (MNRE data)Source: MNRE data](https://solarquarter.com/2026/08/12/indias-solar-capacity-surpasses-164-gw-as-2026-installations-approach-29-gw-by-july-end/)[75  lakhHouseholds targeted for rooftop solar under PM Surya Ghar by December 2026, on the way to 1 croreSource: PIB](https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=2268992)

Panchamrit

## India's Five Climate Commitments

Announced by Prime Minister Narendra Modi at COP26 in Glasgow. Every solar plant built in India counts towards them.

- 1

India will reach its non-fossil energy capacity to 500 GW by 2030.

- 2

India will meet 50 percent of its energy requirements from renewable energy by 2030.

- 3

India will reduce the total projected carbon emissions by one billion tonnes from now onwards till 2030.

- 4

By 2030, India will reduce the carbon intensity of its economy by less than 45 percent.

- 5

By the year 2070, India will achieve the target of Net Zero.

The five commitments in the Prime Minister's words, from his national statement at COP26, Glasgow, 1 November 2021 ([PIB](https://pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=1768712)).

Schemes & Policies

## Schemes That Matter for Solar

Every central scheme, tax rule and norm that shapes a solar project in India, as of October 2026: who it is for, the key points, its status, where we fit, and a full guide on each.

| Scheme or policy | For | Status (Oct 2026) | In depth |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana | Homes & housing societies | Open; apply on pmsuryaghar.gov.in | Guide |
| PM-KUSUM | Farmers, cooperatives, panchayats, FPOs | Closing: complete by 31 Mar 2027 | Guide |
| Solar in Assam's tea gardens | Tea estates in Assam | In force; check APDCL for current terms | Guide |
| Accelerated depreciation | Businesses that own their plant | Available to business owners | Guide |
| GST on solar at 5% | Everyone buying a solar plant | In force | Guide |
| Net metering and time-of-day tariffs | Grid-connected consumers | In force; 2026 changes in draft | Guide |
| Green Energy Open Access | Consumers of 100 kW and more | In force; state charges vary | Guide |
| ALMM List-I and List-II | Projects covered by the ALMM order | In force from 1 June 2026 | Guide |
| Customs duty on modules and cells | Anyone importing equipment | In force | Guide |
| BIS Quality Control Order | Every plant: modules, inverters, batteries | In force | Guide |
| Storage with solar | Utility tenders and large prosumers | Advisory for future tenders | Guide |

Homes & housing societies

### PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana

Open; apply on pmsuryaghar.gov.in

- Launched on 13 February 2024; approved by the Union Cabinet on 29 February 2024 with an outlay of Rs 75,021 crore
- Central subsidy: Rs 30,000 for 1 kW, Rs 60,000 for 2 kW and Rs 78,000 for 3 kW or more
- Housing societies and RWAs: Rs 18,000 per kW for common facilities, up to 500 kW
- Collateral-free loans of around 7% for home systems up to 3 kW; Indian-made (DCR) modules and a registered vendor required
- Target: 75 lakh households by December 2026, on the way to 1 crore

**Where we fit:** The scheme is aimed at homes. For businesses the equivalent levers are depreciation, 5% GST and net metering, which our CAPEX plants are built around.

[Read the full guide](https://arraysingenieria.com/pm-surya-ghar-subsidy/)[Source: PIB](https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=2268992)

Farmers, cooperatives, panchayats, FPOs

### PM-KUSUM

Closing: complete by 31 Mar 2027

- Component A: grid-connected solar plants of 500 kW to 2 MW on farmers' land, power bought by the DISCOM
- Component B: standalone solar pumps, with 30% central support (50% in the North-East, hill states and islands) plus state support
- Component C: solarisation of grid-connected pumps, individually or by whole feeders
- Financial closure for Components A and C extended to 30 November 2026; completion by 31 March 2027, with no further extension
- PM-KUSUM 2.0, with about 10 GW for agri-photovoltaics, announced but not yet notified

**Where we fit:** Component A and feeder-level plants are ground-mount plants: the piling, fencing, civil works, installation and commissioning we do every day.

[Read the full guide](https://arraysingenieria.com/pm-kusum-scheme/)[Source: Energetica India](https://energetica-india.net/news/mnre-extends-pm-kusum-financial-closure-deadline-to-nov-30)

Tea estates in Assam

### Solar in Assam's tea gardens

In force; check APDCL for current terms

- Tea garden owners may use up to 5% of their land for solar generation, as announced by the Chief Minister
- Assam's goal: 6,000 MW of installed green energy capacity by 2030; its solar policy targets about 3,500 MW of solar
- Clean-energy incentives for tea, coffee and rubber units buying from APDCL have included annual energy banking

**Where we fit:** We have built ground-mount plants across Assam's tea gardens, from Koomber (inaugurated by the Chief Minister) to Harmutty, with DG synchronisation and APDCL approvals.

[Read the full guide](https://arraysingenieria.com/solar-for-assam-tea-estates-guide/)[Source: Himanta Biswa Sarma, 22 Sep 2026](https://himantabiswa.substack.com/p/rewriting-assams-energy-future)

Businesses that own their plant

### Accelerated depreciation

Available to business owners

- Solar power generating systems are depreciated at 40% a year on the written-down value
- The Income-tax Act, 2025 applies from 1 April 2026; the 40% rate for qualifying solar assets is reported to continue
- Half the year's depreciation if the plant is used for less than 180 days in its first year

**Where we fit:** Every plant we build on the CAPEX model belongs to the client, so the depreciation is theirs. Confirm the position with your chartered accountant.

[Read the full guide](https://arraysingenieria.com/accelerated-depreciation-solar/)[Source: Taxguru: Income-tax Act, 2025](https://taxguru.in/income-tax/depreciation-income-tax-act-2025-section-34-rates-provisions.html)

Everyone buying a solar plant

### GST on solar at 5%

In force

- The 56th GST Council cut GST on solar cells, modules and specified devices from 12% to 5%, effective 22 September 2025
- EPC contracts: 70% goods at 5% and 30% services at 18%, about 8.9% overall
- The Andhra Pradesh High Court upheld the 70:30 method for a solar EPC contract in December 2025

**Where we fit:** We set out supply and services clearly in every CAPEX quotation, so the tax treatment is transparent from the start.

[Read the full guide](https://arraysingenieria.com/gst-on-solar-india/)[Source: pv magazine India, 4 Sep 2025](https://www.pv-magazine-india.com/2025/09/04/gst-on-solar-cells-modules-cut-to-5/)

Grid-connected consumers

### Net metering and time-of-day tariffs

In force; 2026 changes in draft

- Net metering up to 500 kW or the sanctioned load, whichever is lower, under the national consumer rules; states set the details
- Above that, net billing or gross metering
- Time-of-day tariffs make solar hours cheaper and evening peaks dearer
- Draft amendment of March 2026 proposes charges above 5 kW and storage above 500 kW; check whether it has been notified

**Where we fit:** We handle net-metering applications, inspections and CEIG approvals; at Borpatra Tea Estate we obtained the approvals from APDCL.

[Read the full guide](https://arraysingenieria.com/net-metering-india/)[Source: Mercom India](https://www.mercomindia.com/government-proposes-amendments-to-electricity-consumer-rights-rules)

Consumers of 100 kW and more

### Green Energy Open Access

In force; state charges vary

- Buy green power from an off-site plant from 100 kW of load (down from 1 MW); captive consumers have no minimum
- Connections in the same electricity division can be aggregated (2023 amendment)
- Single-window applications on the national GOAR portal, with deemed approval if not decided in time
- The ISTS charges waiver ended for projects commissioned after 30 June 2025 and is phasing out in steps

**Where we fit:** Captive and open-access plants are ground-mount plants: we do the piling, civil works, fencing and installation & commissioning.

[Read the full guide](https://arraysingenieria.com/green-energy-open-access/)[Source: GOAR portal](https://greenopenaccess.in/)

Projects covered by the ALMM order

### ALMM List-I and List-II

In force from 1 June 2026

- List-I sets which solar modules may be used in covered projects
- From 1 June 2026, List-II for solar cells applies: covered projects need List-I modules made with List-II cells
- Exemptions for projects whose bid deadline was before the amendment, and for net-metering and open-access projects commissioned before 1 June 2026
- A List-III for wafers is reported for June 2028

**Where we fit:** We do not manufacture modules, so we specify the ALMM-listed or client-approved makes each project needs and keep the documents.

[Read the full guide](https://arraysingenieria.com/almm-list-ii-solar-cells/)[Source: PIB](https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=2082901)

Anyone importing equipment

### Customs duty on modules and cells

In force

- Budget 2025-26: BCD on modules cut to 20% with a 20% AIDC (about 40% combined); on cells to 20% with 7.5% AIDC
- Budget 2026-27 left the headline rates unchanged and removed duty on a solar-glass input
- Anti-dumping duty on Chinese-origin cells and modules recommended in September 2025; check the current notification

**Where we fit:** For most C&I and scheme projects the route is now Indian ALMM modules; we compare options and paperwork before you commit.

[Read the full guide](https://arraysingenieria.com/solar-import-duty-india/)[Source: Energetica India](https://www.energetica-india.net/news/union-budget-2025-26-solar-cells-and-modules-duty-cut-to-20-percent)

Every plant: modules, inverters, batteries

### BIS Quality Control Order

In force

- Solar Systems, Devices and Components Goods Order, 2025, notified 27 January 2025
- Modules, solar inverters and storage batteries must meet Indian Standards and carry the BIS mark
- Inverters above 200 kW given extra time on self-certification, reportedly to the end of 2026

**Where we fit:** We check BIS and ALMM documents for every component on site and hand them over with the test reports.

[Read the full guide](https://arraysingenieria.com/solar-quality-standards-bis-cea/)[Source: PIB](https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=2097219)

Utility tenders and large prosumers

### Storage with solar

Advisory for future tenders

- Power Ministry advisory (Feb 2025): two-hour co-located storage equal to 10% of capacity in future solar tenders
- Viability gap funding for battery storage; a second tranche of about Rs 5,400 crore announced in 2025
- ISTS waiver for co-located BESS commissioned by 30 June 2028

**Where we fit:** We build the solar side and can plan for storage; for most C&I owners a plant sized to daytime load pays back fastest.

[Read the full guide](https://arraysingenieria.com/battery-storage-with-solar/)[Source: pv magazine India](https://www.pv-magazine-india.com/2025/02/20/power-ministry-mandates-co-locating-energy-storage-with-solar-projects/)

Quick Guide

## Which Applies to You?

 | If you are… | Look at | How we can help |
| --- | --- | --- |
 | A home | PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana, through the National Portal | We do not install home systems; use a registered vendor on the portal. |
| A farmer, FPO or panchayat | PM-KUSUM Component A: ground-mount plants of up to 2 MW | We build ground-mount plants: piling, civil works, installation and commissioning. |
| A factory or business | CAPEX ownership, accelerated depreciation and net metering | Our core work: CAPEX solar EPC. |
| A tea estate in Assam | Up to 5% of garden land for solar; CAPEX or developer programmes | 19 tea-estate plants built: see our work. |
| A developer or EPC company | Projects under any of the above | Hire us for installation & commissioning and civil works. |
| Anyone buying a plant | GST on solar devices now 5%; ALMM List-I modules with List-II cells where the order applies | We price with current GST and specify ALMM-listed makes: read the guide. |

Scheme rules, subsidies and rates change. This page summarises official sources as of October 2026; always confirm the current terms on the official portal before you invest.

How It Works

# How a Solar Project Works with Us

How solar makes power, the three ways to work with us, and every step from your first call to a plant generating power.

How Solar Works

## From Sunlight to Savings

What happens inside a grid-connected solar plant.

Sunlight → solar modules make DC power → the inverter converts it to AC → your site uses it → surplus is exported to the grid through a net meter.

Choose Your Path

## Three Ways to Work With Us

[1CAPEX / full EPC: **Own your plant**For factories, businesses and tea estates

- We design, supply, build and commission the complete plant
- You pay once and own everything
- Civil works, approvals and handover included
Learn more](https://arraysingenieria.com/capex-solar-epc/)[2Installation & commissioning: **Build for a developer or EPC**For EPC companies and OPEX/RESCO developers

- You own the design and the equipment
- Our veteran-led crews install and commission
- Work to your specifications and approved makes
Learn more](https://arraysingenieria.com/solar-installation-commissioning/)[3Piling & civil works: **Foundations & civil only**For any solar project that needs groundwork

- Pile foundations for module structures
- RCC, pre-cast boundary walls, chain-link fencing
- Proven on SECI 300 MW and Tata Motors 5.5 MW
Learn more](https://arraysingenieria.com/service-civil/)

Step by Step

## Your Project, From Enquiry to Energised

The journey for a CAPEX or full-EPC plant. For I&C and civil work we join at the steps you need.

- 1

### Enquiry

You contact us with your site, your power use and what you want built.

**You get:** A call with our team, the same week

- 2

### Site survey & load study

We visit your roof or land, study your load profile, your grid connection and any diesel generators.

**You get:** Survey findings and a recommended plant size

- 3

### Design & proposal

System design, bill of quantities and a scope-of-work matrix showing exactly what we supply and what you supply.

**You get:** A clear quotation and scope matrix

- 4

### Order & mobilisation

Your purchase or work order, then a site safety plan and a day-by-day programme.

**You get:** Programme, safety plan, named site lead

- 5

### Procurement

Tier-1 modules, inverters and balance-of-system equipment, or the makes you have approved.

**You get:** Equipment delivered to site

- 6

### Civil & structures

Pile foundations or roof works, module mounting structures, fencing and boundary walls where needed.

**You get:** Foundations and structures, checked for level and alignment

- 7

### Installation

Modules, DC and AC cabling, inverters and boards, earthing, lightning protection, module cleaning system and DG synchronisation where needed.

**You get:** A complete, inspected plant

- 8

### Approvals & commissioning

Net-metering and DISCOM approvals and inspections, testing, and grid synchronisation.

**You get:** A plant generating power

- 9

### Handover & support

As-built documents, test reports and equipment warranty papers handed over, your team shown how to run the plant; O&M support if you want it.

**You get:** Your plant, fully documented

Who Owns What

## Under CAPEX, It Is All Yours

### You own

- The complete plant and all its equipment
- Every unit of power it generates
- All the savings, for the life of the plant
- The tax benefit, for businesses
- The manufacturers' warranties

### Arrays Ingenieria

- Is paid once to design, supply, build and commission
- Owns nothing in your plant
- Offers O&M support only if you ask for it

[Full CAPEX ownership table](https://arraysingenieria.com/capex-solar-epc/#who-owns-what)

Before & After

## What We Need, What You Get

### What we need from you

- Access to the roof or land, and its ownership or lease papers
- Recent electricity bills and your DISCOM consumer number
- Your load pattern and working hours
- Details of any diesel generators on site
- A point of contact who can sign approvals

### What you receive at handover

- As-built drawings and the final bill of quantities
- Test and commissioning reports
- Manufacturers' warranty documents for the equipment
- Net-metering approval papers, where applicable
- Operation guidance for your team

Get Started

## Ready When You Are

Tell us your site and your power use; we will take it from there.

Quality, Safety & Environment

# Built Right. Built Safe.

Triple ISO certified and run by ex-servicemen: quality, safety and care for the site are how we work, not paperwork.

Certified

## Three ISO Certifications

Tap a certificate to view it full size.

**ISO 9001:2015**Quality management

Documented processes, inspections and checks so every plant is built to its design and specification.

**ISO 14001:2015**Environmental management

Sites kept tidy and managed with care for the land, the estate and the neighbours.

**ISO 45001:2018**Occupational health & safety

Planned, supervised work so that everyone on site goes home safe.

On Every Site

## How We Keep Quality & Safety

01: **Plan before we build**

Method statements, a site safety plan and a programme agreed before work starts.

02: **Right people, right gear**

Trained crews with the personal protective equipment each task needs.

03: **Checked at every stage**

Foundations, structures, cabling and earthing inspected as the work goes up, to the client's or EPC's inspection plan.

04: **Tested before switch-on**

Pre-commissioning tests before a plant is synchronised with the grid.

05: **Clean, safe sites**

Materials stored safely and sites left clean at handover.

06: **Accountable leadership**

A named site lead, with direct access to the company's veteran leadership.

Case Study · Tea Estate · Inaugurated by the CM

# Koomber Tea Estate: 595 kWp Solar Plant, Inaugurated by the Chief Minister of Assam

On 1 October 2026 the Chief Minister of Assam, Dr Himanta Biswa Sarma, inaugurated the 595 kWp ground-mounted, on-grid solar power plant at Koomber Tea Estate in Cachar district. Arrays Ingenieria was the installation partner.

The Project

## About the Koomber Tea Estate, Assam project

The plant is part of the 3.11 MW Goodricke Tea Estates Solar Programme, developed with Tata Power Renewable Energy Ltd. (TPREL) and Sustvest, which brings clean energy to Goodricke's tea estates across Assam.

On behalf of the company's Chief Executive Officer, Lt. Gen. A.R. Prasad (Retd), AVSM, VSM, ADC, Ph.D, Shri Ranveer Singh welcomed the Chief Minister with a traditional Assamese gamosa. At the inauguration the Chief Minister said the state government is working to promote tea-garden tourism and to connect tea gardens with solar power, so that they become more self-reliant in energy.

The plant was built by the Arrays Ingenieria team, including the ex-servicemen Shri Birendra and Shri Dinesh, with the guidance of Shri Kundal Kant Singh, Abhinanda Basu, Shri Santosh Singh and Baliram of TPREL, and Shri Hardik (CEO) and Shri Devyansh of Sustvest.

The inauguration was announced by the Chief Minister's Office on X and Facebook, posted by MLAs Kaushik Rai and Rajdeep Goala, and reported by The Sentinel on its website, Facebook and Instagram.

### Our scope of work

- Installation of the 595 kWp ground-mounted plant
- Electrical works and grid connection
- Testing and commissioning
- Handover for inauguration

### In the news

Why It Matters

## Driving the PM's Panchamrit and the CM's Green Assam mission

The Chief Minister's Office said the plant "empowers iconic tea industry with clean energy and accelerates the mission towards a Green Assam". The Sentinel reported that it aligns with the government's efforts to promote its Green Assam mission.

By cutting fossil-fuel use in energy-intensive tea processing, the plant also contributes to the Prime Minister's Panchamrit commitments made at COP26, and to Assam's target of 6,000 MW of green-energy capacity by 2030.

Case Study · Tea Estate · Ground-Mount

# Jay Shree Tea: 1 MW Solar at Towkok & Manjushree Tea Estates

Two ground-mount, grid-connected solar plants for Jay Shree Tea & Industries, part of the BK Birla Group: 535 kWp at Towkok Tea Estate and 500 kWp at Manjushree Tea Estate, together about 1 MW, in Sonari, Assam.

The Project

## About the Jay Shree Tea, Assam project

Jay Shree Tea placed the purchase order with Arrays Ingenieria on 2 December 2024 for the material supply, installation and commissioning of a 1035 kWp grid-connected solar power generation system across the two estates. The project was executed under Tata Power's EPC contract, with all materials to Tata Power-approved makes.

Both estates run on grid power backed by diesel generators, so the scope included synchronising each plant with two DG sets per site, letting the estates use solar power alongside their generators.

The plants were inaugurated on 20 May 2025. It was the first renewable-energy project in Jay Shree Tea's 80-year history, and was reported by The Sentinel and announced by Jay Shree Tea on Instagram, Facebook and LinkedIn.

### Our scope of work

- AC LT power cabling (1.1 kV, armoured XLPE)
- Cable trays and conduits with supporting structures
- Lightning arrestors
- Chemical earthing system with all associated civil work
- Module cleaning system (HDPE pipe network)
- Safety equipment to Tata Power standards
- Synchronisation with two DG sets at each site
- Testing and commissioning

### In the news

[Online news: **The Sentinel**22 May 2025Assam: AIPL commissions 1 MW solar power plant at Jayshree Tea Estate](https://arraysingenieria.com/recognition/#sentinel-jayshree)[Client post: **Jay Shree Tea & Industries Ltd.**22 May 2025Jay Shree Tea commissions 1 MW solar plant in Assam](https://arraysingenieria.com/recognition/#jayshree-towkok)

### Photos

## Project facts

Capacity: **1035 kWp (535 + 500 kWp)**

Plant type: **Ground-mount, on-grid**

Location: **Sonari, Charaideo district, Assam**

Client: **Jay Shree Tea & Industries Ltd. (BK Birla Group)**

Partner / programme: **Tata Power Renewable Energy Ltd. (EPC contract)**

Our role: **Material supply, installation & commissioning**

Year: **2025 (inaugurated 20 May 2025)**
